_comment: The inventory of every guardrail Heimdall enforces, each in exactly one tier. Format: docs/schemas/guardrails.manifest.v1.json. Validator: bin/lib/guardrails_manifest.py. Drift test: test/guardrails-manifest-drift.test.sh. core = security and correctness gates: never switchable by any hmd command or config file; a core guard keeps only the per-process operator_env override it already honours, read from the guard's own environment. recommended = cost and discipline guards: on by default, listed, switchable by the operator (a recommended hook with hmd hooks disable <id>). Anything not positively classified is core. kind feature = a hook that is not a guardrail, listed so every hook has a row. A row with layer hook IS a hook of hooks/hooks.json: id and hook are its id in hooks/hooks.metadata.json and it is core exactly when it is locked. Any other layer is a guard living inside a hook (precheck-bash inside bash-gate-chain, precheck-agent inside agent-precheck), a native git hook emitted by bin/heimdall-init, or a script. fails is what the guard does when it cannot reach a verdict and is informational only: core does not mean fails closed (the commit-time secret scan, git-guard, the attribution trailer and most spawn fences degrade open on purpose). proof names the nearest suite that runs the guard; for parallel-gate and parallelism-tracker-read that is a suite of the hook wiring and of the tracker binary, not of the heuristic itself. provisional marks a tier that is core only because the guard has not been classified yet (plan open decision O5). The file is descriptive: enforcement lives in the guards themselves.

guardrails.why: a prompt that looks multi-part gets a delegation directive before the model answers (heuristic nudge)
prints the context-window meter notice
a prompt carrying a pasted credential is refused so the value is never transmitted
adds the current compression level to the context of every prompt
delivers companion-app inbox messages at prompt submit
drops a stale phone stop request at prompt submit so it cannot end the next turn
the Bash hook (bin/heimdall-precheck-bash): the commit and push gate stack plus the cost guards listed under it
never pay CI minutes to re-roll a flaky result: empty commits, workflow re-runs and re-dispatches are refused
clears a proven-stale index lock and heals a corrupted core.bare or core.hooksPath before a git write; best effort, never blocks
a secret in the staged diff blocks the commit (gitleaks); a missing scanner only warns here, the push gate requires it
a test run or an agent spawn is refused while the disk is under the free-space floor (the spawn fence lives in precheck-agent; test/run-all.sh keeps its own floor)
a full test sweep the records already answer is refused: after a red sweep, at a HEAD already proven green, or beside a running sweep
foreground poll loops, sleeps of a minute or more and tail -f are refused: run the job in the background and wait for its notification

at a merge (a merge of refs, a pull request merge, a pull on or a push to the default branch) the developer is shown whether a full test run is worth it: why, the exact command and its cost in time and tokens; advice only, it never blocks and never speaks at any other moment
pkill, killall and a kill of a computed pid are refused: one by-name kill once unpaired two live phones
a push needs the pushed repository's own green record: heimdall's sweep receipt (heimdall-state check-quality-gates) or its repo-checks receipt
a secret in the push range, or a missing scanner, blocks the push (gitleaks --require)
a secret anywhere in heimdall's own full history, or a missing scanner, blocks the push (bin/heimdall-selfscan)
an oracle gate that cannot go red (bin/falsify score under 1.0) blocks the push; deferred to the native pre-push hook when that is wired
a case the gates once caught that is no longer caught blocks the push (bin/corpus run); deferred to the native pre-push hook when that is wired
advisory parallelism-tracker check at the tail of the Bash chain; it can never block
a repository that declares its own checks (.heimdall/repo-checks.json) is pushed only on a green, current receipt of them (bin/heimdall-repo-checks); the gate reads the receipt and never re-runs them
counts Read, Grep and Glob calls for the parallelism grade
the Agent hook (bin/heimdall-precheck-agent): spawn fences and rewrites; each denies only on a confirmed finding and every plumbing gap allows
warns that a name: on a spawn makes the agent mailbox-resident: it never returns a result and the spawner owns its cleanup
caps in-process agent spawns with a self-expiring lease count; opt-in: armed only while HEIMDALL_INPROC_AGENT_MAX is set
a judge (reviewer, verifier, security auditor) is never spawned on a loopback-routed fallback gateway: a degraded model emits confident false greens; no bypass flag
a coop-listed role is refused on the native spawn path, which cannot route it and would silently leave it unrouted; no bypass flag
a spawn past the hard context ceiling at a clean boundary is refused: save, compact, then re-spawn
warns past three finding-fix spawns in a session: only BLOCKER and HIGH findings get a fix agent; advice only
a general-purpose spawn gets a short rules block appended: no foreground polling, long jobs in the background, an explicit timeout on every Bash call
an oversized brief-less spawn prompt is rewritten to a real delta brief; a brief store that cannot be verified refuses the spawn
unfinished code never lands: Write and Edit content that matches an unfinished-code shape is refused; no escape hatch
warns before an edit when a live teammate holds a claim on the file; advisory, never a lock
credential-bearing files are not read into model context by Read, Grep, Glob or Bash
a failing lint, format or type check is fixed in the code: edits to the linter, formatter or typechecker config are refused
a risky shell command or outside-the-repo write is held briefly so a paired phone can deny it; the phone only reduces what runs, and no phone means no hold
delivers companion-app inbox messages before a tool runs
honours the phone's interrupt before a tool runs
captures a failed oracle report into the regression corpus after a Bash call
logs every edit and marks the state dirty, which arms the pre-push quality gate; autocommits at five changed files
throttled background context sync after an edit
writes a journal entry when a Bash call landed a commit
delivers companion-app inbox messages after a tool ran
honours the phone's interrupt after a tool ran
session start wiring: autoupdate check, statusline, trackers, state init, presence beat, cleanup advice
probes a checkpoint on resume and prints its head
prints the maintain-loop resume hint
prints the quota-resume hint
prints the dream notice for the repo
starts this session's presence keeper in the background
prints the presence connect prompt
runs the AI-tool selection at session start
a claude-mem daemon never keeps a routing or fallback credential in its environment (credential egress fix C-1)
prints the compression rules into session context
warns about ANTHROPIC_* overrides persisted in a Claude Code settings.json env block
warns when the clone sits on volatile disk holding unpushed work
records the session and opens the repo's pair-by-code window
records this session's wake coordinates for the inbox watcher
starts the inbox watcher so an idle session is woken by a phone message
re-injects the /hmd:continue handoff once after a compaction
records a task outcome for the finished subagent
marks a subagent rate limit for fallback routing
metric reminder at main-agent Stop
flags a stale present-tense process-status claim in the final message
marks a main-session rate limit for fallback routing
batch-lints every path edited this session at Stop and records a real lint receipt
delivers companion-app inbox messages at Stop, holding the turn open for a connected phone
re-arms the inbox watcher at the end of every turn
stops this session's presence keeper
farewell, then checkpoint, autocommit, grade, cleanup and summary in a detached worker
forgets this session and closes the pair-by-code window when no phone is paired
writes .planning/CHECKPOINT.md before compaction rewrites context
the commit gates (stub scan, oracle falsifiability, corpus regression) run from git itself, for a human or a tool outside Claude Code; HMD_SKIP=1 proceeds but logs an unproven-merge receipt
the push gates run from git itself, and the Bash chain defers the oracle and corpus gates to it when it is wired; HMD_SKIP=1 proceeds but logs an unproven-merge receipt
appends the hmd co-author trailer to every commit, even under --no-verify; bookkeeping, never blocks
